name: letter-relay
title: Letter Relay
description: A large hero name shrinks and travels into a fixed header slot letter by letter as you scroll the first screen, so the name hands itself to the navigation.

meta.reducedMotion: The hero name and the header name are both static; no scroll listener runs.
meta.useWhen: Portfolios and personal brands where the name is the identity.
meta.avoidWhen: Long names (over ~16 characters); pages without a fixed header; product pages.
